summary: First round of E2E testing for Thay Nail Designer (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend pytest: 18/18 passed covering auth (login OK/401, /auth/check), services (seed + CRUD + 401 unauth), work_days (list + update + revert + invalid times + 401), blocked_slots (list/create/delete + 401), appointments (public booked, list 401, create + 409 duplicate). Frontend Playwright: home hero canvas renders and frame pixel changes on scroll (scroll-driven animation confirmed), 5 seeded services rendered on public site, contact hours dynamic (Domingo/Quarta/Sexta/Sábado present with correct times), booking calendar disables Monday and enables Saturday, Saturday shows slots 10:00-17:00, booking creates + confirmation screen shown. Admin: login wrong password shows error, correct password (1611) opens panel; Schedule tab toggles Tuesday to available (save indicator), reverts to closed; block-date add/remove works. Services tab: create new service with image upload, edit price, delete – all confirmed and catalog restored to 5 services.

issues: React hydration console warning: <span> cannot be child of <option>. Likely caused by dev-time instrumentation library (x-file-name/x-excluded attributes on <span> inside <option> in Booking.jsx service dropdown). Cosmetic only; doesn't affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).

seed_data seeds services/work_days only when collections are empty; changing DEFAULT_SERVICES/DEFAULT_WORK_DAYS after first run won't take effect (documented behavior, but idempotent upsert per key would be safer).
PUT /api/services/{id} accepts full ServiceIn but doesn't validate price/duration >= 0. Same for POST. Frontend validates but backend should too for defense in depth.
CORS default '*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec but works because credentials aren't sent from browser. Recommend explicit origins in production.

Booking.jsx: generateTimeSlots stops when h*60+m < endMin; a slot starting at close-59 is still generated (e.g. closing 18:00 -> 17:00 slot fine, but for 60min durations the actual service would finish after closing_time). Consider using service duration_minutes when generating slots.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded services + work_days. Test appointments created: (2035-06-14 10:00) via pytest and (2026-09-26 16:00 TEST_UI_Client) via UI – both pending, non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and run in ~6s with pytest-xdist (2 workers). Uses ADMIN_PASSWORD=1611. Test data prefixes: TEST_ for services, TEST_UI_/TEST_Client for appointments. TEST appointments from prior runs persist in DB and may cause duplicate-409 on the same date/time slots — pick different date+time if needed. Hero scroll animation validated by comparing canvas center pixel before/after scroll (pixel changed 192,173,159 -> 249,222,214).
